brief:
Muhammad Abu Salah of Jenin launched a small business making handmade rugs after job opportunities outside Palestine diminished following the start of the Gaza war, the Palestine News Network reported. The young entrepreneur drew inspiration for the venture from a TikTok idea he encountered online.

Abu Salah turned to self-employment as employment prospects contracted in the region during the conflict.
dek: JENIN, West Bank / PNN / As job opportunities outside Palestine dwindled after the war in Gaza began, Muhammad Abu Salah of Jenin turned to self-employment, launching a small business making handmade rugs after drawing inspiration from an idea he saw on…
title: Palestinian entrepreneur launches handmade rug business after Gaza war
